scene_duration: Enter the total scene length in seconds. Existing animation keyframes and painted gestures retain their timing.
soundtrack: Continue soundtrack repeats the chosen audio clip to the end of the presentation. It respects the clip's start and trims and carries its musical position across scene changes.
default: A previously saved presentation keeps its authored audio timing until continuation is enabled.

verification.scope: Selected native playback, AAC movie export, project persistence, rendered painting and UI checks on Mac and iPadOS and visionOS simulators.
verification.movie: A synthetic audio file changes pitch each second. The test decodes the exported AAC soundtrack and measures pitch before and after the original end and across a scene cut, with continuation enabled and disabled.
verification.painting: An image rendered at 22.4 seconds in the extended scene has the same pixel values as the original painting at 14.9 seconds and differs visibly from the opening frame.
verification.physical_devices: Hardware acceptance on a physical iPad or headset was outside these checks.

mac_preview: Installed development-signed Mac preview. The running editor displayed the original scene duration, soundtrack switch, track name and Apply control.
